name: mesa
description: Provides libraries and drivers for graphics APIs like OpenGL and Vulkan, including libGL, libEGL, libgbm, and Gallium3D/VA-API drivers.
build: meson setup mesa-25.3.5 mesa-25.3.5/build --prefix="$XORG_PREFIX" --buildtype=release -D platforms=x11,wayland -D gallium-drivers=llvmpipe,radeonsi,r300,r600,nouveau,zink -D vulkan-drivers=amd -D valgrind=disabled -D video-codecs=all -D libunwind=disabled --wrap-mode=nodownload
